title: Structuring and Raising Debt & Equity for Real Estate
description: It is not enough to buy a great deal at the right price. The investment’s capital structure must be structured optimally to match the strategy and business plan for the deal and its investors. Structuring and Raising Debt & Equity for Real Estate sheds light on the various types of lenders and equity investors and deal structures so that you can better put together your next investment. In this book, you will also learn strategies to source and attract debt and equity partners, which are two key relationships in the real estate investment business. In Rob’s previous bestselling book, The Definitive Guide to Underwriting Multifamily Acquisitions, he shares his process of analyzing a potential investment from A to Z. In this new book, Rob takes you through the next step of understanding real estate capital structures and how to raise debt and equity for your next real estate investment. "Structure trumps strategy in many cases and it is often undervalued. Taking advantage of promote crystallization, or 1031 exchange transaction options within syndicated deals or funds are two things often overlooked for example. description: The uncomfortable truth about wealth building that nobody wants to hear: You're probably wasting money on things that keep you poor while telling yourself you'll invest "someday." That someday needs to be today. Most Americans are broke. Not temporarily short on cash—genuinely broke. Eighty-five percent have zero retirement savings. Seventy-eight percent live paycheck to paycheck. The average person couldn't cover a $400 emergency without going into debt. Meanwhile, Social Security is projected to run out of money by 2034, pensions have virtually disappeared, and the cost of everything keeps rising. The retirement crisis isn't coming. It's already here. And if you're not actively building wealth right now, you're going to be one of its victims. But here's the good news: You don't need a six-figure income, an inheritance, or special connections to escape this fate. You need a system that actually works, the discipline to execute it, and the willingness to live differently than everyone around you. This book provides that system. It's not get rich quick. It's not fast. It's not easy.
